text:
Alex K: Hey team — can someone run a short focused SKU comparison for a long-ctx workload? Need H100 / A100 / L40S numbers for 2k vs 8k seq lengths. Primary targets: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput (tokens/s), and a quick NVLink traffic heatmap. Also want to compare BF16 vs INT8 quant profiles. Can we capture SM utilization, memory clocks, and power as well?

Sophia L.: I can take this. Suggest using the nightly bench harness with the new --kv-prefix-cache flag off to avoid masking cold-cache variance. Example command: 
```
./bench-runner --model redwood-1b --seq-len 2048,8192 --profiles bf16,int8 --metrics sm_util,mem_clock,power,nvlink --output /tmp/sku-probe.json --runs 3
```
I’ll push sensor logs to S3 and attach CSVs. Need to know preferred NUMA/cpu pinning. :eyes:

Sam I.: Heads-up H100-03 is in running jobs until 10:30 PST, but A100 rack-7 and L40S-01 are free. If you want a more 'clean' comparison, schedule H100 for after 11:00 or use preemptible isolation on the H100 queue. I can reserve A100 and L40S now.

Alex K: Reservation sounds good — please reserve A100 and L40S. For the H100, after 11:00 works. For CPU pinning, please set --affinity=cccpin (one core-per-GPU for the benchmark) and disable background processes with the bench wrapper. Also enable NVPROF-like counters in sampling mode (low overhead).

Jordan M.: Quick note — for INT8 paths make sure to run both quantized kernel and fallback kernel traces. Last time we saw kernel fallback for long context on L40S at 8k which skews tail latency. Add env var: EXPORT KERNEL_TRACE=1 in the harness.

Sophia L.: Will do. I’ll include a short kernel trace snippet and mark whether fallback happened. Plan: 3 cold-start runs + 5 steady runs, capture pX and tokens/s. Posting a draft PR that adds nvlink counters to the bench schema — pinging for review @Jordan M.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-20260315-97 on A100 rack-7 (id: b-8972). Estimated start: 2026-03-15T09:45:00Z.

Sam I.: Reserved L40S-01 (b-8973) and A100-r7 (b-8972). H100 slot booked for 11:15 (b-8974). I set GPU isolation flags and bumped job priority for this run.

Alex K: Awesome — thanks. Sophia, can you also capture driver versions and a short note on thermals (if any throttling) so we can correlate with clock/power? After results are in, we’ll decide whether to run a full overnight sweep. :+1:

Sophia L.: Yep — will include driver/OS, nvml snapshots, and a simple thermal time series. ETA for initial results: today EOD PST.

Jordan M.: I’ll review the PR when it lands. If we see kernel fallback on L40S at 8k, we should flag it for the runtime team (might need a kernel dispatch tweak).

Alex K: Great. Thanks everyone — post results in this thread and attach the CSVs and a 3-line summary highlighting any regressions or unexpected behavior.
